meta.title: Fix cartesia audio gaps and improve continuity
meta.body_summary: Fix audio gaps in cartesia synthesizer by adding fallback metadata when text_queue empty, reducing task manager sleep, and optimizing context switching.

core_change_summary.description: In cartesia_synthesizer.py, added fallback metadata creation when text_queue is empty to prevent audio chunk drops; in task_manager.py, reduced sleep from 0.2s to 0.01s; also optimized context switching to update only on turn_id changes and initialized an audio_buffer for future continuity improvements.
change_trajectory: Single commit (01e65271) made all changes: reduced sleep, added metadata fallback, and context switching rule.
